mapper.select: select (select count(*) from time_doser.base_user) as allUserCount, (select count(*) from time_doser.base_user where createdate between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY) and current_date) as yesterdayCount, (select count(distinct base_user_id) from time_doser.plan_task_history a left join time_doser.base_user b on a.base_user_id = b.id where b.createdate between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY) and current_date) as yesterdayUsedCount, (select sum(tomato_work_time) from time_doser.plan_task_history where creat_time between DATE_ADD(current_date, INTERVAL -1 DAY) and current_date) as yesterdayCreatTimeCount
